title: ToolResult
description: Result of an executed tool call, with full provenance and cache/staleness information.

tool_call_id.description: Identifier of the originating tool call.

data.description: Structured tool output, null on error.

source_type.description: Provenance category of the returned data.

retrieved_at.description: Time the data was retrieved by the tool layer (ISO 8601).

data_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the underlying data itself, null if unknown.

is_cached.description: True if served from local cache.

staleness_seconds.description: Age of the data in seconds, null if unknown.

error.description: Error message when status is not success, null otherwise.
